title: HelperSessionReplayParams
description: One recorded capture, and where in it the caller wants screens. A capture is not a session: nothing is spawned, no PTY exists and no inventory row is minted — this is a reading of bytes through the emulator that may produce frames at all (ADR-0066 keeps the one emulator in the helper, and cmd/nocx-server is built CGO_ENABLED=0).

through.description: How many chunks have been consumed at each mark, non-decreasing, one entry per frame the caller wants. The arithmetic belongs to the caller that owns the capture FORMAT (internal/agentcapture.ChunksThrough) and is deliberately not repeated on this side: two derivations of 'which chunk belongs to this mark' agree everywhere anybody looks and disagree on the day one of them moves.

chunks.description: The capture's bytes in stream order, base64 on the wire. RAW BYTES and never a JSON string: a PTY stream is not UTF-8, and encoding it as text would replace every byte that is not a valid sequence with U+FFFD before the emulator ever saw it — a replay that answers about a stream nobody recorded.
